# Read dataset and summirize data for each CoupleID
```{r}
## Read data

data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Combined_dataset_filtered.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Change names of Drosophila lines
### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6",
  "L7" = "Par7",
  "MT47" = "Mon47",
  "W140" = "Wat140",
  "W120" = "Wat120",
  "W148" = "Wat148",
  "Sok28" = "Day28",
  "Sok58" = "Day58",
  "Sok80" = "Day80",
  "S24" = "Sap24",
  "S11" = "Sap11",
  "T3" = "Tok3",
  "T10" = "Tok10",
  "T18" = "Tok18"
)

for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  data <- change_name(data, old_strain, new_strain)
}

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1810 rows)
data <- data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

merged_data <- data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

```

# Add information about location, infection status and cross type
```{r}

# Add columns Continent and Area
##Define continents for the Drosophila lines
Europe <- c("Par6", "Par7", "Mon47", "Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "SFL", "Am", "CTIFL", "BalT", "RennesT", "TrentoT", "Am^Bal", "Am^Trento", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6")
America <- c("Wat120", "Wat140", "Wat148", "Day28", "Day58", "Day80")
Asia <- c("Tok18", "Tok10", "T11", "Tok3", "Sap11", "Sap24", "Kor", "China")

merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Continent = determine_continent(Male, Europe, America, Asia)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Continent = factor(Continent, levels = c("Europe", "America", "Asia"))) #To do Europe first

##Add column Area
  merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Area = dplyr::case_when(
    Continent == "Europe" ~ "Invasive",
    Continent == "America" ~ "Invasive",
    Continent == "Asia" ~ "Native",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_  # To handle any unexpected values
  )) %>%
  dplyr:: mutate(Area = factor(Area, levels = c("Invasive", "Native")))

  ##To check information added
merged_data[is.na(merged_data$Continent),]

# Add column female and male infection status
## Define infected and uninfected categories
infected_categories <- c("Tok3", "Tok10", "T11", "Wat148", "Wat140", "Par6", "Day28", "Sap24", "Bal", "SFL", "Day58", "Rennes", "Trento", "Kor", "China", "Am^Bal", "Am^Trento", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6")
uninfected_categories <- c("Am", "Tok18", "Day80", "Wat120", "Mon47", "Par7", "BalT", "RennesT", "TrentoT", "Sap11", "CTIFL")

## Apply the function to both females and males
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::mutate (FemaleInfect = get_infection_status(Female, infected_categories, uninfected_categories)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate (MaleInfect = get_infection_status(Male, infected_categories, uninfected_categories))

## Check the infection status of each strain is assigned
merged_data[is.na(merged_data$FemaleInfect),]

# Add column description of cross
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
dplyr::mutate(Cross = as.factor(determine_cross(MaleInfect, FemaleInfect))) %>%
dplyr:: mutate(Cross = factor(Cross, levels = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-", "Test cross W- x W+", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+")))
```

# Add information about number of Couples For each CrossType
```{r}

##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

## Export file with hatch rates per Couple_ID
write.table(x = merged_data, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

# Figure 1 
# Reorder factors and choose only nessesary CrossTypes
```{r}

# Load the data
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Filter and keep data only for screen for CI (1031 rows)
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = as.factor(CrossTypeLabel))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

## Maybe do not keep the data from batch 6 and 7 for some crosses that were also made before (e.g. AmxAm, RennesxRennes, Par6xPar6, TrentoxTrento, AmxBal, BalxAm, BalxBal, etc.)
## Maybe keep RennesxMon47 here and present RennesxAm only for the control of the introgressed lines and Par6 with Am?
data1 <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::filter(!CrossType %in% c("BalTxBalT", "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT", "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "RennesTxAm", "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxRennesT", "AmxCTIFL", "CTIFLxAm","CTIFLxCTIFL", "BalxCTIFL", "CTIFLxBal", "BalxPar6", "Par6xBal", "BalxMon47", "Mon47xBal", "BalxDay58", "Day58xBal", "BalxTok10", "Tok10xBal", "BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal", "SFLxMon47", "Mon47xSFL", "Mon47xRennes", "RennesxMon47", "Mon47xMon47", "Sap11xSap24", "Sap24xSap11", "Par7xBal", "BalxPar7", "T11xTok18", "Tok18xT11", "AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm","AmxAm^Trento","Am^TrentoxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm", "AmxAm^Rennes","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm", "AmxAm^Par6","Am^Par6xAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm", "Par7xPar6","Par7xPar7", "Par6xPar7"))

# Making clones for AmxAm, Tok18xTok18, Wat120xWat120 and Day80xDay80
## Duplicate AmxAm
#Am <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (data1, "AmxAm", 3)

## Duplicate Tok18xwTok18
#Tok18 <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (data1, "Tok18xTok18", 4)

## Duplicate Wat120xWat120
#Wat120 <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (data1, "W120xW120", 1)

## Duplicate Day80xwDay80
#Day80 <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (data1, "Day80xDay80", 1)

## Combine the original row and the cloned rows (1396 rows)
#data1 <- dplyr::bind_rows(data1, Am, Tok18, Wat120, Day80) %>%
#dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))



# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
#data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Am/Am",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento") ~ "Am/Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "BalxAm", "BalxBal") ~ "Am/Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes") ~ "Am/Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxPar6","Par6xAm", "Par6xPar6") ~ "Am/Par6",
    CrossType %in% c("Day80xDay80") ~ "Day80/Day80",
    CrossType %in% c("Day28xDay28", "Day80xDay28", "Day28xDay80") ~ "Day80/Day28",
    CrossType %in% c("Day58xDay58", "Day80xDay58", "Day58xDay80") ~ "Day80/Day58",
    CrossType %in% c("Wat120xWat120") ~ "Wat120/Wat120",
    CrossType %in% c("Wat140xWat140", "Wat120xWat140", "Wat140xWat120") ~ "Wat120/Wat140",
    CrossType %in% c("Wat148xWat148", "Wat120xWat148", "Wat148xWat120") ~ "Wat120/Wat148",
    CrossType %in% c("Tok18xTok18") ~ "Tok18/Tok18",
    CrossType %in% c("Sap24xSap24", "Sap24xTok18", "Tok18xSap24") ~ "Tok18/Sap24",
    CrossType %in% c("Tok10xTok10", "Tok10xTok18", "Tok18xTok10") ~ "Tok18/Tok10",
    CrossType %in% c("Tok3xTok3", "Tok3xTok18", "Tok18xTok3") ~ "Tok18/Tok3",
    CrossType %in% c("KorxKor", "KorxTok18", "Tok18xKor") ~ "Tok18/Kor",
    CrossType %in% c("Tok18xChina", "ChinaxTok18", "ChinaxChina") ~ "Tok18/China", TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

# Assign countries using information in Pair
data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Country = as.factor(sapply(Pair, assign_country)))

#Change names for control pairs "Tok18/Tok18", "Am/Am", "Wat120/Wat120", "Day80/Day80"
data1 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Country = ifelse(Pair %in% c("Tok18/Tok18", "Am/Am", "Day80/Day80","Wat120/Wat120"), "Control W-", as.character(Country))) 

# Plot hatch_rate
data1 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
change_name <- function (data, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new)
    )

  data <- change_name(data, old_strain, new_strain)
```

# Create a Figure 1 violin plot
```{r}
## Creat the order for the graph
median_hatch_rate$Country <- factor(median_hatch_rate$Country, levels=c("Control W-","Italy", "France", "USA", "China", "Korea", "Japan"))

median_hatch_rate_reduced$Country <- factor(median_hatch_rate_reduced$Country, levels=c("Control W-","Italy", "France", "USA", "China", "Korea", "Japan"))

## Change Year as a factor
median_hatch_rate <-median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year = as.factor(Year))

violinplot1 <- median_hatch_rate[median_hatch_rate$Continent == "Europe",] %>% 
  ggplot2::ggplot (aes(x=CrossTypeLabel, y=hatchrate, fill = Cross), size=100) +  geom_violin()+
  #ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = x_label_names) +
  #ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_dotplot(data = median_hatch_rate[median_hatch_rate$Continent == "Europe",], aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate, color = Year, fill= Year), binaxis='y', stackdir='center', dotsize=0.5)+
 #ggplot2::geom_point(data = median_hatch_rate[median_hatch_rate$Continent == "Europe",], aes(x = CrossType, y = hatchrate, color = Year), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size = 3) +
 ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate), y=1.2), vjust = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-" = "#00bfc4", "Test cross W- x W+" = "#F8766D", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-" = "#7cae00", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" = "#c77cff", "2023" = "#931F1D", "2024" = "#00008B")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c ( "2023" = "#931F1D", "2024" = "#00008B")) + 
  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Median hatch rate and individual hatch rates per cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Cross type") +

  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20, "pt"),
        #strip.background = element_blank(),  # Removes background from facet labels
        strip.placement = "outside", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 45, hjust = 1), #modify the text of the axis x
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        title = element_text(size = 0), #face="bold" makes it bold
        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )
```

# Create a Figure S1 crosses in 2023 and 2024 separretly
## Load and filter the data 
```{r}

library(purrr)
library(altmeta)

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (1810 rows)
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Filter only necessary CrosTypes 
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(Year =as.factor(Year))

data1 <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::filter (Continent=="Europe") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!CrossType %in% c("BalTxBalT", "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT", "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "RennesTxAm", "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxRennesT", "AmxCTIFL", "CTIFLxAm","CTIFLxCTIFL", "BalxCTIFL", "CTIFLxBal", "BalxPar6", "Par6xBal", "BalxMon47", "Mon47xBal", "BalxDay58", "Day58xBal", "BalxTok10", "Tok10xBal", "BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal", "SFLxMon47", "Mon47xSFL", "Par7xBal", "BalxPar7", "AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm","AmxAm^Trento","Am^TrentoxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm", "AmxAm^Rennes","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm", "AmxAm^Par6","Am^Par6xAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm")) ##554 rows

```

## Figure S1 for crosses in 2023

```{r}

# Create data frame for Couple analysed in 2023
data1_2023 <- data1 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Year=="2023") 

# Add information about number of Couples For each CrossType
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- data1_2023 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count_2023 = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel2023 = paste0("(", Couple_count_2023, ") ", CrossType))

## Merge the new labels with the data
data1_2023 <- data1_2023 %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data1_2023 <- data1_2023 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Am/Am",
```

```{r}
#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (506 rows)

# Filter only necessary CrosTypes

# Choose crosstypes
data2 <- merged_data %>%
 dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal", "Par7xPar6", "Mon47xRennes" , "AmxBal", "AmxPar6", "AmxRennes"))

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data2 <- data2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("Mon47xRennes", "AmxRennes") ~ "Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxPar6", "Par7xPar6") ~ "Par6",

    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs

  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))
```

# Add information from the zero-inflated model about median hatch rate for figure S6

```{r}

dataS6 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Intrastrain_Batch2_full.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Add information about AmxPar6 Cross
dataS3_Par <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Batch.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

dataS3_Par <- dataS3_Par |>
  dplyr::filter (type == "cond.CrossTypeAmxL6")

dataS6 <- dplyr::bind_rows(dataS6, dataS3_Par) |>
dplyr::mutate(type=factor(type))

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

#Change name of L6 to Par6
change_name <- function (data, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      uninfstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(uninfstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      infstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(infstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      type = stringr::str_replace_all(type, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
    )}

### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6",
  "L7" = "Par7",
  "MT47" = "Mon47"
  )

for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  dataS6 <- change_name(dataS6, old_strain, new_strain)
}

#Quick plot for the models results
ggplot(dataS6, aes(x = CrossType, y = Estimate, color = infstrain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ infstrain, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

dataS6 <- dataS6 |>
 dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("Mon47xBal", "Par7xBal", "Par7xPar6", "Mon47xRennes" , "AmxBal", "AmxPar6", "AmxRennes"))

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=dataS6, y=data2[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male", "Continent", "Pair", "Cross", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>

    ))

  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r}
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6",
  "L7" = "Par7",
  "MT47" = "Mon47",
  "W140" = "Wat140",
  "W120" = "Wat120",
  "W148" = "Wat148",
  "Sok28" = "Day28",
  "Sok58" = "Day58",
  "Sok80" = "Day80",
  "S24" = "Sap24",
  "S11" = "Sap11",
  "T3" = "Tok3",
  "T10" = "Tok10",
  "T18" = "Tok18"
)

change_name <- function (data, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data <- data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new)
    )
}
for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  data <- change_name(data, old_strain, new_strain)
}
data <- data |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))|>
  dplyr::select (-Couple_count) |>
  dplyr::select (-CrossTypeLabel)

data3 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter (Batch ==6 | Batch ==7) |>
  dplyr::filter(!CrossType %in% c("BalTxBalT", "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT", "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "RennesTxAm", "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxRennesT", "AmxCTIFL", "CTIFLxAm","CTIFLxCTIFL", "BalxCTIFL", "CTIFLxBal", "BalxPar6", "Par6xBal", "BalxDay58", "Day58xBal", "BalxTok10", "Tok10xBal", "BalxTrento", "TrentoxBal", "SFLxMon47", "Mon47xSFL", "BalxPar7", "Par7xBal", "Par6xPar7", "Par7xPar6", "Par7xPar7", "Par6xPar7", "BalxMon47", "Mon47xBal", "Mon47xMon47", "Mon47xRennes", "RennesxMon47")) ##415 rows

#Count number of Couples only for Batch 5 
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

# Making clones for AmxAm
## Duplicate AmxAm
Am <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (data3, "AmxAm", 1)

## Combine the original row and the cloned rows (967 rows)
data3 <- dplyr::bind_rows(data3, Am) |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
      "AmxAm", 
      "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm","TrentoxTrento",
      "AmxBal", "BalxAm","BalxBal",
      "AmxPar6", "Par6xAm","Par6xPar6",
      "AmxRennes", "RennesxAm","RennesxRennes",
      "AmxAm_clone1",
      "AmxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm","Am^TrentoxAm^Trento",
      "AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm","Am^BalxAm^Bal",
      "AmxAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm","Am^Par6xAm^Par6",
      "AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
data3 <- data3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Control W-",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento") ~ "Am/Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "BalxAm", "BalxBal") ~ "Am/Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxPar6", "Par6xAm","Par6xPar6") ~ "Am/Par6",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes") ~ "Am/Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm_clone1") ~ "Control W- ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Trento", "Am^TrentoxAm","Am^TrentoxAm^Trento") ~ "Amᵀʳᵉⁿᵗᵒ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Bal", "Am^BalxAm","Am^BalxAm^Bal") ~ "Amᴮᵃˡ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Par6", "Am^Par6xAm","Am^Par6xAm^Par6") ~ "Amᴾᵃʳ⁶",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm^Rennes", "Am^RennesxAm","Am^RennesxAm^Rennes") ~ "Amᴿᵉⁿⁿᵉˢ",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("Control W-", "Am/Trento","Am/Bal", "Am/Par6", "Am/Rennes", "Control W- ", "Amᵀʳᵉⁿᵗᵒ", "Amᴮᵃˡ", "Amᴾᵃʳ⁶","Amᴿᵉⁿⁿᵉˢ")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
data3 <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

# Add strain tested type to the database
data3 <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate (M_strain = dplyr::case_when(
    Pair %in% c("Control W-", "Control W- ") ~ "Control W-",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Rennes",  "Amᴿᵉⁿⁿᵉˢ") ~ "Rennes",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Trento", "Amᵀʳᵉⁿᵗᵒ") ~ "Trento",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Bal", "Amᴮᵃˡ") ~ "Bal",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Par6", "Amᴾᵃʳ⁶") ~ "Par6",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(M_strain = factor(M_strain, level=c("Control W-","Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes")))

#Add line type
data3 <- data3 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = dplyr::case_when(
    Pair %in% c("Control W-","Am/Trento", "Am/Bal", "Am/Par6", "Am/Rennes") ~ "Natural lines",
    Pair %in% c("Control W- ","Amᵀʳᵉⁿᵗᵒ", "Amᴮᵃˡ", "Amᴾᵃʳ⁶","Amᴿᵉⁿⁿᵉˢ") ~ "Introgressed lines",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = factor(LineType, level=c("Natural lines", "Introgressed lines")))

# Plot hatch_rate
data3 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossType, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

```{r}
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
```

```{r}
## To do labels with superscript

  c(
    "Amᵀʳᵉⁿᵗᵒ" = "Am^Trento",
    "Amᴮᵃˡ" = "Am^Bal",
    "Amᴿᵉⁿⁿᵉˢ" = "Am^Rennes",

    "Trento" = "Trento",
    "Bal" = "Bal",
    "Rennes" = "Rennes",

  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Median hatch rate and individual hatch rates per cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Cross type") +
   #ggh4x::facet_nested(~LineType , scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ LineType + M_strain, ncol = 5, scales = "free_x", strip.position = "top", drop=FALSE, labeller = labeller(
          LineType = ~ paste("", .),

        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )
```

```{r}
dataS3 <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_InterStrains.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Add information about AmxPar6 Cross
dataS3_Par <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_Batch.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

dataS3_Par <- dataS3_Par |>
  dplyr::filter (type == "cond.CrossTypeAmxL6")

dataS3 <- dplyr::bind_rows(dataS3, dataS3_Par) |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

dataS3 <- dataS3 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

#Change name of L6 to Par6
change_name <- function (data, strain_name_old, strain_name_new) {
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      CrossType = stringr::str_replace_all(CrossType, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      uninfstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(uninfstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      infstrain = stringr::str_replace_all(infstrain, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
      type = stringr::str_replace_all(type, strain_name_old, strain_name_new),
    )}

### To do list of strains
strain_replacements <- list(
  "L6" = "Par6"
  )

for (old_strain in names(strain_replacements)) {
  new_strain <- strain_replacements[[old_strain]]
  dataS3 <- change_name(dataS3, old_strain, new_strain)
}

#Quick plot for the models results
ggplot(dataS3, aes(x = CrossType, y = Estimate, color = infstrain)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ infstrain, scales = "free_x") +
  theme_bw()

dataS3 <- dataS3 |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add information about hatch rate to the dataset
median_hatch_rate <- dplyr::left_join(x=dataS3, y=data4[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "CrossTypeLabel", "hatchrate","Female", "Male", "Continent", "Pair", "Cross", "Batch", "Block", "Year")], by = "CrossType")

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::mutate(Cross = dplyr::case_when(
      Cross == "Test cross W- x W+" ~ "CI cross W- x W+",
      Cross == "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" ~ "Rescue cross W+ x W+",
      TRUE ~ Cross
    ))

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

median_hatch_rate_reduced <- median_hatch_rate_reduced |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

median_hatch_rate <- median_hatch_rate |>
  dplyr:: filter(!is.na(CrossTypeLabel))

# Plot hatch_rate
median_hatch_rate %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossTypeLabel) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

# Create a Figure S1 with tetracycline treated lines (current)
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Load the data for hatch rate per Couple (1810 rows)

merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE)) |>
  dplyr::select(-CrossTypeLabel)

# Filter only necessary CrosTypes 
merged_data <- merged_data  %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID =as.factor(CoupleID))

dataS2 <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% c("AmxAm","BalTxBalT", "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT", "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "RennesTxAm", "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxRennesT", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes")) |> ##380 rows 
dplyr::filter(Batch == 5) ##191

#Count number of Couples only for Batch 5 
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
dataS2 <- dataS2 |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

# Making clones for AmxAm
## Duplicate AmxAm
Am <- duplicate_rows_by_crosstype (dataS2, "AmxAm", 1)

## Combine the original row and the cloned rows (967 rows)
dataS2 <- dplyr::bind_rows(dataS2, Am) |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType=factor(CrossType))

## create an order 
desired_order <- c(
      "AmxAm", 
      "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm","TrentoxTrento",
      "AmxBal", "BalxAm","BalxBal",
      "AmxRennes", "RennesxAm","RennesxRennes",
      "AmxAm_clone1",
      "AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm","TrentoTxTrentoT",
      "AmxBalT", "BalTxAm","BalTxBalT",
      "AmxRennesT", "RennesTxAm","RennesTxRennesT"
   )

# Reorder the rows according to the desired order of CrossType
dataS2 <- dataS2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = desired_order)) 

# Combine all CrossTypes for one Pair
dataS2 <- dataS2 |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = dplyr::case_when(
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm") ~ "Control W-",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "BalxAm", "BalxBal") ~ "Am/Bal",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento") ~ "Am/Trento",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes") ~ "Am/Rennes",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxAm_clone1") ~ "Control W- ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxBalT", "BalTxAm", "BalTxBalT") ~ "Am/Balᵀ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxTrentoT", "TrentoTxAm", "TrentoTxTrentoT") ~ "Am/Trentoᵀ",
    CrossType %in% c("AmxRennesT", "RennesTxAm", "RennesTxRennesT") ~ "Am/Rennesᵀ",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ ))

#Create order for Pairs
pair_levels <- c("Control W-","Am/Trento", "Am/Bal", "Am/Rennes", "Control W- ","Am/Trentoᵀ", "Am/Balᵀ", "Am/Rennesᵀ")

# Convert the Pair variable to a factor with the specified order
dataS2 <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = pair_levels))

# Add strain tested type to the database
dataS2 <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate (M_strain = dplyr::case_when(
    Pair %in% c("Control W-", "Control W- ") ~ "Control W-",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Rennes", "Am/Rennesᵀ") ~ "Rennes",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Trento", "Am/Trentoᵀ") ~ "Trento",
    Pair %in% c("Am/Bal", "Am/Balᵀ") ~ "Bal",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(M_strain = factor(M_strain, level=c("Control W-", "Trento", "Bal", "Rennes")))

#Add line type
dataS2 <- dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = dplyr::case_when(
    Pair %in% c("Control W-","Am/Bal", "Am/Trento", "Am/Rennes") ~ "Natural line",
    Pair %in% c("Control W- ","Am/Balᵀ", "Am/Trentoᵀ", "Am/Rennesᵀ") ~ "Tetracycline-treated line",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_ )) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(LineType = factor(LineType, level=c("Natural line", "Tetracycline-treated line")))

# Plot hatch_rate
dataS2 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = CrossType, y = hatchrate)) +
  geom_point() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(.~ Pair, scales = "free", space = "free", switch = "x") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 3, color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Crosstype", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Hatch rate by Crosstype") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

## Test for difference in Hatch Rate between incompatible and compatible corsses (Pvalues for Fig 1)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
test_dif_hatchrateGLM <- function(pair="Am/Bal", dat=merged_data){
  ## Subset dataset
  dat <- dat[dat$Pair==pair,]
  ## Fit model with a single intercept
  mfull <- glm(cbind(LarvaeCount, UnhatchedEggs) ~ CrossType, data=dat, family="binomial")
  mreduced <- glm(cbind(LarvaeCount, UnhatchedEggs) ~1, data=dat, family="binomial")
  
  summary(mfull)
  summary(mreduced)
  
  res <- anova(mreduced, mfull, test="Chisq")
  
  return(res$`Pr(>Chi)`[2])
}

test_dif_hatchrateGLMM <- function(pair="Am/Bal", dat=merged_data){
  ## Subset dataset
  dat <- dat[dat$Pair==pair,]
  ## Fit model with a single intercept
  mfull <- lme4::glmer(cbind(LarvaeCount, UnhatchedEggs) ~ CrossType + MaleAge +(1|CoupleID)+(1|PetriNumber), data=dat, family="binomial")
  mreduced <- lme4::glmer(cbind(LarvaeCount, UnhatchedEggs) ~ MaleAge +(1|CoupleID)+(1|PetriNumber), data=dat, family="binomial")
  
  summary(mfull)
  summary(mreduced)
  
  res <- anova(mreduced, mfull, test="Chisq")
  
  return(res$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}

pval <- sapply(unique(merged_data$Pair[merged_data$Compatibility%in%levels(merged_data$Compatibility)[1:2]]), test_dif_hatchrateGLMM, dat=merged_data)
pval
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}

test_dif_hatchrateGLMM <- function(pair=c("Am/Bal","Am/Am","Bal/Bal") , dat=merged_data){
  ## Subset dataset
  dat <- dat[dat$Pair%in%pair,]
  ## Fit model with a single intercept
  mfull <- lme4::glmer(cbind(LarvaeCount, UnhatchedEggs) ~ Compatibility + MaleAge +(1|CoupleID)+(1|PetriNumber), data=dat, family="binomial")
  mreduced <- lme4::glmer(cbind(LarvaeCount, UnhatchedEggs) ~ MaleAge +(1|CoupleID)+(1|PetriNumber), data=dat, family="binomial")
  
  summary(mfull)
  summary(mreduced)
  
  res1 <- anova(mreduced, mfull, test="Chisq")
  
  res2 <- summary(multcomp::glht(mfull, multcomp::mcp(Compatibility="Tukey")))
  pval <- c(res1$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], res2$test$pvalues)
  names(pval) <- c("General", names(res2$test$coefficients))
  return(pval)
}
```

## Prepare combined dataset
```{r, eval=FALSE}
combined_data <- dplyr::inner_join(combined_dataEggs, combined_dataLarvae,
                                   by = c("Flip", "CoupleID", "PetriNumber")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(EggCount > 0) %>% 
  na.omit(LarvaeCount) %>% 
  dplyr::inner_join(data, by = "CoupleID") %>% 
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_split(Pair, "/", simplify = TRUE)[, 1] != stringr::str_split(Pair, "/", simplify = TRUE)[, 2]) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Pair != "Bal/Mon47"&Pair != "Bal/Par7") %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Pair, Compatibility) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = unique(CrossType)))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(HatchRate = LarvaeCount/EggCount)

mean_hatch_rate <- combined_data %>% 
  dplyr::group_by(Area, Country, Continent, Pair, CrossType, Compatibility) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(HatchRate = mean(HatchRate),
                   TotalEggs = sum(EggCount),
                   TotalHatched = sum(LarvaeCount),
                   MeanHatchRate = TotalHatched/TotalEggs,
                   Number_PetriDishes = dplyr::n()) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(SEHatchRate = sqrt((HatchRate*(1-HatchRate))/TotalEggs),
                Lower95CI=HatchRate-qnorm(0.975)*SEHatchRate,
                Upper95CI=HatchRate+qnorm(0.975)*SEHatchRate) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Country, as.factor(Pair), as.factor(CrossType))

write.table(mean_hatch_rate, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Mean_hatch_ratePerPetriDishPerCrossType.csv"), quote = FALSE, sep = ";", row.names = FALSE)

# define a vector of colors to use for each Pair


# Create a data frame with the p-values
pval_df <- data.frame(Pair = names(pval),
                      pval = pval,
                      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Merge the p-values with the mean_hatch_rate data frame
mean_hatch_rate <- merge(mean_hatch_rate, pval_df, by = "Pair")

# Create a function to convert p-values to significance labels
get_significance_label <- function(pval) {
  if (pval < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  } else if (pval < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  } else if (pval < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  } else {
    return("ns")
  }
}

# Add significance labels to the data frame
mean_hatch_rate$Significance <- sapply(mean_hatch_rate$pval, get_significance_label)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Calculate CI and SE using delta method
mean_hatch_rate_ic <- mean_hatch_rate %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Compatibility == Incomp)
mean_hatch_rate_c <- mean_hatch_rate %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Compatibility == Comp1)

## Combine data

mean_CI <- mean_hatch_rate_ic_c %>% 
  dplyr::rename(HatchRateIC=HatchRate) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CI = 1-HatchRateIC/HatchRateC)

mean_CI <- mean_CI %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(SE_CI = sqrt((CI*(1-CI))/Number_PetriDishes),
                Lower95CI_CI=CI-qnorm(0.975)*SE_CI,
                Upper95CI_CI=CI+qnorm(0.975)*SE_CI) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(as.factor(Continent), as.factor(Pair), as.factor(CrossType))

write.table(mean_CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Mean_CIPerPetriDishPerCrossType.csv"), quote = FALSE, sep = ";", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
(F4_bar <- ggplot(merged_data_F4, aes(x = reorder(CrossType, desc(FemaleInfect), desc(MaleInfect)), y = MeanHatchRate, fill = Compatibility)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "grey", size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = MeanHatchRate - SE, ymax = MeanHatchRate + SE), width = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(MeanHatchRate, 2)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pair_colors) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)) +
  xlab("Cross Type") + 
  ylab("Mean Hatch Rate") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Pair, ncol = 4, scales = "free_x") +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black")))

merged_data_F4 <- merged_data %>%
  dplyr::select(CrossType, Pair, FemaleInfect, MaleInfect, Compatibility, EggCount, LarvaeCount) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = ifelse(Pair %in% c("Am/Am", "Bal/Bal"), "Am/Bal", 
                              ifelse(Pair %in% c("Par7/Par7", "Bal/Bal"), "Bal/Par7", 
                                     ifelse(Pair %in% c("Bal/Bal", "Mon47/Mon47"), "Bal/Mon47", Pair)))) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Pair %in% c("Am/Bal", "Bal/Par7", "Bal/Mon47")) 

## Duplicate data from Bal as it also used as a control for Par7
merged_data_F4_Bal2 <- merged_data_F4 %>%
  dplyr::filter(CrossType == "BalxBal") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = "Bal2xBal2", Pair = "Bal/Par7") 

## Duplicate data from Bal as it also used as a control for Mon47
merged_data_F4_Bal3 <- merged_data_F4 %>%
  dplyr::filter(CrossType == "BalxBal") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = "Bal3xBal3", Pair = "Bal/Mon47")

# Compute mean hatch rate
mean_hatch_rate_merged_data_F4 <- dplyr::bind_rows(merged_data_F4, merged_data_F4_Bal2, merged_data_F4_Bal3) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Pair, FemaleInfect, MaleInfect, Compatibility, CrossType) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(HatchRate = mean(LarvaeCount/EggCount),
                   TotalEggs = sum(EggCount),
                   TotalHatched = sum(LarvaeCount),
                   MeanHatchRate = TotalHatched/TotalEggs,
                   Number_PetriDishes = dplyr::n()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(SEHatchRate = sqrt((HatchRate*(1-HatchRate))/TotalEggs),
                Lower95CI = HatchRate - qnorm(0.975)*SEHatchRate,
                Upper95CI = HatchRate + qnorm(0.975)*SEHatchRate) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(Pair, Compatibility) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = factor(CrossType, levels = levels(mean_hatch_rate_merged_data_F4$CrossType)))

str(mean_hatch_rate_merged_data_F4)

## Create vector of labels for x axis
CrossType <- levels(mean_hatch_rate_merged_data_F4$CrossType)
CrossType[CrossType=="Bal2xBal2"] <- "BalxBal"
CrossType[CrossType=="Bal3xBal3"] <- "BalxBal"

write.table(mean_hatch_rate_merged_data_F4, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Mean_hatch_ratePerPetriDishPerCrossTypeControCrossesOnly.csv"), quote = FALSE, sep = ";", row.names = FALSE)
```
